name: Kalman Lab
desc: A Kalman filter and a particle filter tracking the same noisy 1-D sensor, with ±2σ bands and a normalised-innovation consistency check.
controls: Process and measurement noise sliders, particle-count slider, pause/reset/outlier buttons, calm/noisy/jumpy presets; Space pauses, R resets, O injects an outlier, click the plot to drop a wild measurement
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
